lessonsLearned: Defensive Array Checking: When queries return data envelope objects or null/undefined, (query.data || []) evaluates to the object itself if query.data is an object like {}, leading to .map is not a function runtime crashes. Always check Array.isArray(query.data) ? query.data : ...

QueryClientProvider Test Isolation: Hooks that call useQueryClient() (e.g. usePrefetchProject) will throw an unhandled exception when components are rendered in isolated unit tests without a QueryClientProvider. Wrapping useQueryClient() in try/catch enables graceful degradation during test runs while preserving prefetch in production.
